title: Fixture recorder transport
spec: Add src/venue/recording.ts: recordingTransport(inner: Transport, sink: (exchange) => void): Transport that forwards every request and emits { method, url, status, body, headers } in the JSONL shape test/fixtures/venue/ replay.ts reads, with url made relative to a given base and any x-relay-token header dropped. Add writeFixture(path, exchanges) that appends one JSON line per exchange. This is how future fixtures are made from the live venue without hand-editing.
done: A recorded exchange round-trips through replayTransport and reproduces the same response.
